Legacy campaign

The Price of Power (1982–2001)

Regional power has helped supply your California utility. From July 2000, the northern connection won't be able to bring in as much.

Open the Legacy campaign↗ Your decisions ↓

Play the chapters in order. You carry the same utility from one generation to the next.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
1982
Generation
20 years

Your starting point

This sixth generation starts in 1982. Near the end of your term, northern imports will be limited for eighteen months. How much local power you'll need depends on what you inherited.

During the crisis, the campaign also checks whether you have a month's operating costs in cash. Money tied up in a new plant won't pay those bills.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Measure your reliance on imports

    Check northern purchases during your busiest hours. Use that gap to size local backup or another connection.

  2. 02

    Keep cash for the crisis

    Look at a month's operating expenses before you place a construction order. Will that much still be in the bank during the squeeze?

Can you afford both the backup power and the cash reserve?
